purpose: Turn broad creation work into an explicit microstep workflow whose logical chronology remains plan -> pre-step perspective analysis -> bounded action/result -> post-step perspective analysis -> revise/split/replan/advance, even when the entire workflow executes inside one fast call.

properties.operation: prepare, start, checkpoint, record-analysis, execute, record-result, split, replan, instant, or inspect
properties.request: optional ordinary machine request used only to attach deterministic anatomy/direction decomposition to planning
properties.checkpoint: exact checkpoint prepared for the current workflow digest and step
properties.analyses: executor-supplied perspective analyses keyed by the exact prepared specialist ids
properties.result: external JSON-serializable result for analysis-only or externally executed steps
properties.evidence: explicit evidence references for a recorded external result
properties.substeps: two or more smaller replacement steps when a checkpoint requires SPLIT
properties.replacement_steps: replacement remaining plan when a checkpoint requires REPLAN
properties.step_records: instant mode chronological per-step pre analyses, optional result, and post analyses

contains: parallel planning tournament before plan selection
current workflow cursor and per-step state
best/middle/low/random perspective checkpoint before each action
best/middle/low/random perspective checkpoint after each result
chronological timeline proving logical stages even for instant execution

relationships: uses the specialist pool as a changing set of eyes before and after each meaningful step rather than only once at the beginning
keeps historical best-fit perspectives in the panel while deliberately retaining middle, low-ranked and deterministic-random challengers
can invoke any already live creation capability as an action step without bypassing that capability's own boundaries
does not pretend that prepared perspective packets analyzed anything until a human/model/cognition provider supplies their actual analyses
allows broad work to be recursively split into smaller steps when any supplied checkpoint identifies unresolved independent work

anatomy_refs.basis: Preparation runs a multi-perspective planning tournament and validates the selected explicit dependency-ordered step plan.
The runtime advances through typed workflow states and bounded transitions, including split, replan, hold and completion.
Every unit of work is an explicit step with one purpose, expected evidence, stop condition, dependencies and result state.
Pre/post checkpoints reuse detailed contextual specialist profiles rather than a single undifferentiated analysis voice.

limitations: the deterministic workflow engine orchestrates planning, checkpoints and live capability calls but does not itself supply semantic specialist reasoning
the most conservative checkpoint transition is a control rule over supplied analyses, not proof that the strictest perspective is objectively correct
recursive splitting is bounded to depth 8 and 128 total steps to prevent unbounded decomposition
instant staged execution preserves logical chronology in receipts but does not imply wall-clock delay between stages
a step with no live capability route holds rather than inventing execution
persistent_state: none in v0; the caller carries digest-bound workflow state, while specialist fit history remains owned by the specialist-tournament ledger

truth.basis: Every plan, checkpoint, result, split and transition is explicit; no analysis or execution is claimed when only a packet was prepared.

agency.basis: Plans remain selectable and revisable, perspective disagreements stay visible, and no checkpoint gains authority beyond controlling the declared workflow transition.

continuity.basis: Each workflow state is digest-bound and contains a chronological timeline plus retired/replanned step evidence.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Fast execution cannot skip the logical pre-analysis and post-analysis boundaries; broad work can be split before continuing.
